articles.title: Justice of the Peace Gregory Johnson to kick off re-election campaign in downtown Killeen
articles.excerpt: Johnson, a Democrat first elected in 2020 and a former two-term Killeen City Council member, launched his 2024 re-election campaign (July 25, 2024).

articles.title: Judge Johnson wins re-election in JP race
articles.excerpt: Johnson won re-election to Precinct 4, Place 1 on Nov. 5, 2024 with about 57.5 percent of the vote.

articles.title: Bell County rings in new year by swearing in elected officials
articles.excerpt: Johnson was sworn in for a new four-year term on Jan. 1, 2025.
